name: Haithem Turki
tagline: A lost engineer trying to make sense of a crazy, crazy world
body:
Stanford 2012 graduate with a bachelor's in CS, on leave from the MS CS program. Forward Deployed Engineer at [Palantir Technologies](https://www.palantir.com/) ever since. Follower of sports teams that cause me heartbreak. Proud brother of Phi Kappa Psi.
